official.deadline_note: The scholarship itself publishes no application deadline - applicants are automatically considered when they apply for a course. Course application closing dates govern: direct start-year 2027 (Semester 1) intake applications close 30 November 2026, mid-year 2027 (Semester 2) close 31 May 2027.
official.application_cycle: 2027 commencement year; scholarships awarded from 2027 carry the new 20% fee sponsorship
official.status_note: Official page lists application status as 'Open for automatic consideration'.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Amount published as '20% fee remission'. From 2027 the scholarship provides a 20 per cent fee sponsorship for the duration of the course; scholarships awarded before 2027 provided 25 per cent. Tuition fee sponsorships apply to Overseas Fee places and cover the cost of tuition in part; the student is responsible for the remaining cost of tuition.
official.funding_period: % of tuition fees for the duration of the course
benefits: Scholarships awarded before 2027 provide a 25 per cent fee sponsorship for the duration of the course.
From 2027, the scholarships provides a 20 per cent fee sponsorship for the duration of the course and the number of scholarships will increase to 225.
Benefit duration: One or more years; quantity: at least 110.
The scholarship can be deferred to the following academic year.
eligibility: Be a citizen of a country with a Gross Domestic Product per capita of US$10,000 or less based on data published by the World Bank.
Have received an offer for an Overseas Fee place in a bachelors degree for commencement in the year the scholarship is offered.
Not have previously undertaken tertiary studies (excluding extension studies completed as part of a year 12 program).
Eligible study level: Undergraduate; eligible student type: International students; study stage: Future study.
requirements: This scholarship is subject to the Coursework Scholarships Conditions.
The scholarship cannot be held with another scholarship or sponsorship that provides a fee sponsorship or discount.
Selection scores are reviewed annually and may vary between years.

Note (Coursework Scholarships Conditions): the minimum average result for the Melbourne Chancellor's Scholarship and Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship providing a 25%, 50% or 100% fee remission is 70.
documents: No scholarship documents or separate scholarship application - automatic consideration upon applying for a course.
Course application documents: academic transcripts, predicted or final results, English language test results (if applicable) and documents for any selection tasks.
selection_criteria: The scholarship is offered to the student(s) ranked highest based on their final secondary school or foundation studies results.
Scholarship selection is not based on predicted results.
coverage: Tuition fee sponsorships are applied to Overseas Fee places and cover the cost of tuition in part or in full; if the sponsorship covers part of the cost of tuition, the student is responsible for the remaining cost of tuition.
application_method: You are automatically considered for this scholarship, if you have applied for a course.

Apply direct to the University of Melbourne through the online application portal (overseas secondary qualification or foundation studies), or through VTAC (Australian Year 12 or IB Diploma completed in Australia/NZ for the start-year intake).
Successful candidates will be notified of the outcome within five working days of receiving a course offer; unsuccessful candidates will not be notified.
official.application_route: Apply for admission to a University of Melbourne bachelor degree (direct via the online application portal, or VTAC for eligible start-year applicants); automatic consideration, no separate scholarship application.
official.study_mode: Full-time standard (student visa holders must study full-time); part-time enrolment continues scholarship benefits per the Coursework Scholarships Conditions
official.citizenship_residency: Must be a citizen of a country with a GDP per capita of US$10,000 or less (World Bank data), per the University's published eligible countries list.
official.international_eligibility: Eligible - the scholarship is for international students holding an Overseas Fee place.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No agency restriction. Published study areas: Agricultural and veterinary sciences; Architecture, building, planning and design; Arts, humanities and social sciences; Business and economics; Education; Engineering; Environment; Health; Information technology and computer science; Law; Music, visual and performing arts; Science.
official.duration: One or more years (for the duration of the course)
official.description: The Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship is offered to talented students who are enrolling in a bachelor degree and are citizens of countries where international educational opportunities are limited by financial disadvantage.
official.english_requirement: University of Melbourne undergraduate entry requirement (not stated on the scholarship page itself): most bachelor degrees require English Level 1 - IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in writing, speaking, reading and listening, or TOEFL iBT 81 (writing 19, speaking 19, reading 16, listening 16), or equivalent accepted tests; prior approved study in English or an approved foundation/bridging pathway may also satisfy it. Check the specific course page for its required level.

not_confirmed: funding_currency - the benefit is published as a 20% fee remission (percentage), not a currency amount
deadline_central - no fixed scholarship application deadline is published (automatic consideration)
Per-qualification minimum selection scores - the official page states scores are reviewed annually and may vary, but publishes no current figures
verification.notes: Amount (20% fee remission from 2027; 25% before 2027), eligibility, selection, conditions and automatic application route verified on the University of Melbourne scholarships page; eligible-country list, Coursework Scholarships Conditions (70 average, tuition sponsorship terms), application routes and closing dates, and undergraduate English requirements verified on the University's own unimelb.edu.au domains.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an automatic, merit-ranked partial tuition discount rather than a scholarship you apply for: the University of Melbourne assesses admitted students holding an Overseas Fee place and awards the highest-ranked citizens of its eligible countries a 20% fee remission that runs for the whole course from 2027. Because there is no separate application, only two things decide the outcome - your citizenship being on the University's GDP-per-capita list, and your final secondary or foundation results, not an essay or interview. Winners are told within five working days of their course offer and losers are never told, so plan your finances as though you will pay the remaining 80% of Overseas Fee tuition plus all living costs until a scholarship letter actually arrives.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Top final-scoring school leavers from the University's eligible lower-GDP countries who can self-fund the remaining 80% of Overseas Fee fees and living costs.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your citizenship against the University's eligible countries list before investing time in an application - the US$10,000 GDP-per-capita rule is applied strictly.

Use the correct admission route: direct application via the University's online portal for overseas qualifications and foundation studies, or VTAC for an Australian Year 12 or an IB completed in Australia/NZ for the start-year intake.
Work to the course closing dates, since they gate scholarship consideration: direct start-year 2027 intake applications close 30 November 2026 and mid-year 2027 closes 31 May 2027.
Have English evidence (test score or approved prior study in English) ready inside the course application - the scholarship has no separate English requirement of its own.
Confirm you have never undertaken tertiary study (year 12 extension subjects are the only exception) and are not holding another fee discount or sponsorship.
common_rejection_risks: Any prior tertiary study, even an incomplete or unaccredited course, disqualifies you outright; only year 12 extension studies are excluded from the rule.
Citizenship that is not on the published eligible list blocks eligibility, so dual nationals must check which passport applies.
Selection uses final achieved results only - applicants whose final results are released after the offer round rank below those with confirmed results.
Holding another scholarship or sponsorship that provides any fee sponsorship or discount makes this award unholdable.
Under the Coursework Scholarships Conditions, falling below the required average mark (70 for these fee-remission awards) can halve or suspend the tuition sponsorship.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 80% of Overseas Fee tuition from 2027, plus living costs, flights, visa costs and overseas student health cover - the award covers tuition only.
document_audit: There is no scholarship form, essay, referee report or scholarship-specific CV - everything rides on the single course application.
Citizenship is effectively evidenced by the passport details in your course application, so mismatched records between your passport and application can stall assessment.
Transcripts and English evidence must satisfy admission requirements first - without an Overseas Fee offer there is nothing for the scholarship to attach to.
If you defer, the scholarship moves only to the following academic year; skipping a second year forfeits it.
alerts: The benefit steps down from 25% to 20% for scholarships awarded from 2027 while the number of awards rises to 225 (at least 110 previously).
No scholarship deadline exists, but intake application closing dates do - missing the course closing date ends consideration for that intake.
Unsuccessful applicants receive no notification, so silence is the only signal you did not win.
It cannot be stacked with any other fee-sponsorship or discount, including external sponsorships.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One step: submit the course application (direct to the University's portal or via VTAC as applicable) - scholarship assessment runs with admission and outcomes follow the course offer by about five working days.
